Try a different browser. DRINK WELL DO GOOD SSBCO IN 2018, WE TOOK A GIANT LEAP INTO THE UNKNOWN. OUR DREAM: TO BRING PEOPLE TOGETHER, WITHOUT RESERVATION, WHERE WE CAN KICK BACK, RELAX, LAUGH, AND GET TO KNOW EACH OTHER JUST A LITTLE BIT BETTER. WE WANT EVERYBODY TO EXPERIENCE HOW CRITICAL IT IS TO HAVE A HEALTHY AND HAPPY COMMUNITY THAT SUPPORTS ONE ANOTHER. WE JUST THINK IT HAPPENS A BIT EASIER OVER A FRESH, LOCALLY CRAFTED BREW. TOP BEERS SEVEN New England India Pale Ale | 6.9% Seven Is our original New England India Pale Ale that was tirelessly concocted (and tested!) in a garage during home-brewing days. Hazy, juicy, and slightly bitter; this IPA drinks smooth and citrusy. Generously hopped with Apollo, Citra, Vic Secret, and Simcoe. FLYWHEEL New England Pale Ale | 7% Flywheel packs a hop punch with noticeable bitterness and strong flavors of watermelon, citrus, and stone fruits. generously hopped with Citra, Mosaic, and El Dorado. the only thing we are missing is a working flywheel at the brewery that is fed with this delicious IPA! FIRE ROAD Red Rye Ale | 7.1% A fire road provides access to a typically remote, un-developed area. This is our fire road to an often overlooked style of beer, a red rye ale. It's spicy, slightly sour, malty with a touch of bitterness, and has an oak finish. This beer is bursting with flavors and is perfectly balanced to pair with any occasion. FLUME Double India Pale Ale | 8.2% After long days in the mountains, there are many tales of loggers riding timber down flumes back to their camps to enjoy libation. Anyone crazy enough to risk life and limb for a post work beer deserves a big, flavorful IPA. This hazy Double IPA delivers a perfect balance of bitterness and sweetness with bold citrus and stone fruit flavors stemming from the generous Citra and Galaxy hop additions. SEQUOIA West Coast India Pale Ale | 6.8% The west coast introduced us to the big and bold IPA. Sequoia, known for its immense power and beauty, is the inspiration for our representation of this style of beer that delivers a malty sweetness, piney bitterness, and clean dry finish. Enjoy this high IBU IPA hopped with CTZ, Centennial and Cascade hops. Much respect to the west coast hoppy beers! WHIPSAW Witbier | 5.2% Whipsaw is a German-style Witbier (Wheat Beer) that pours cloudy and combines a perfect amount of spice and citrus from coriander, orange peel, and Mt. Hood hop additions. Crushable by itself, or if you are feeling frisky, pair it with some carbonated lemonade for a refreshing summer shandy! VIEW FULL BEER LIST UPCOMING EVENTS Join us for a good time. juiciest Double IPA to the most decadent pastry stout. We are continually inspired by our surroundings, both in Door County and from our friends and fellow craft brewers across the country/world. Cans All of our canned beers are brewed, fermented, and packaged in our brewing facility in Baileys Harbor. Most of these brands are only brewed once or twice a year, so be sure to grab them when you see them. Bottles Our bottled beers spend time fermenting and aging down the street from our main brewing facility, in our dedicated barrel facility. These beers take time and patience—most of them taking 1-2 years to produce. Many of these beers are produced with locally sourced ingredients, as we attempt to highlight time and place in a bottle. Visit any of our Eppig Brewing locations and experience a legacy soaked in tradition and brewed for today. | Welcome to Eppig Brewing Co. | EppigBrewing | Skip to Main Content OUR BEERS ABOUT LOCATIONS EVENTS CONTACT VIEW CRAFT BEER WHO WE ARE Eppig Brewing, an award-winning craft brewery based in San Diego, California, carries a rich legacy that dates back over a century. Originally founded by brothers Joseph and Leonhard Eppig, their brewing empire flourished through the early 1900s, even weathering the challenges of Prohibition in its own discreet way. Nearly 150 years after the first family brewery was established in Brooklyn, New York, Stephanie Eppig and her partners proudly revived the Eppig Brewing tradition, bringing its storied history and dedication to exceptional craft beer into the modern era. Throughout the year, we host a variety of incredible events that bring together great beer, good food, and amazing people. Signature celebrations like Oktoberfest and Frühlingsfest are fan favorites, featuring festive vibes, exclusive merchandise, and special beer releases you won’t find anywhere else. But that’s just the beginning our calendar is packed with unique events, from seasonal parties and themed nights to interactive gatherings that make every visit memorable. Explore our Events Page to see what’s coming up next and make plans to join us for an unforgettable time at Eppig Brewing! cdjdgvc.txt: About | Peace Water Winery | Close | CashApp | Apple Pay | Google Pay | Visa | Mastercard | American Express | Discover | JCB | Peace Water Winery logo | Customer account | Cart icon | Open menu | | Peace Water Winery logo | CashApp | Apple Pay | Google Pay | Visa | Mastercard | American Express | Discover | JCB | About | Peace Water Winery | Peace Water Winery | | LOCATIONS PRIVATE EVENTS OUR WINEMAKER OUR WINES KITCHEN MENU MORE OUR STORY ONE BOTTLE DOES A WORLD OF GOOD My wife Laura is the kindest person I know. Somehow she has enough love in her heart to raise eight children, three dogs, two horses, two cats and even an orphaned cow. Despite all the organized chaos, she still finds a way to think of others... whether it is volunteering at schools, running a soup kitchen, or just practicing random acts of kindness. It was a typical crazy weekend (six basketball games, four soccer matches, and an equestrian event) spent scrambling from one place to another in our 1966, 21-window Volkswagen "hippie van." We squeezed in a stop at our local Starbucks drive-thru and, as was her tradition, Laura paid for the double chocolate chip frappuccino the car behind us had ordered. The kids all smiled as they watched the joyous reaction of the lucky recipient. That's when I realized we needed to do something more. What better way to do it than to share great wine with you! If the simple act of buying a stranger a cup of coffee can make someone's day, what can happen if we really set our minds to making a difference. So while our family is large, our vision is larger. We truly believe the smallest act of kindness has a ripple effect that can help change the world. 50% of our net profits will be donated to charity, both locally and across the world. Enjoy our wine knowing every sip is helping make this world a better place! PEACE OUT! Here you crush real grapes, bottle 240 custom-labeled wines, and leave knowing exactly what you made. We have been making wine in Hicksville, Long Island since 2010, and we make wine with more than 1,000 people every year, most with zero experience. Event Booking Page Trusted by: Make Wine on Long Island We've been doing this in Hicksville since 2010. Most wineries give you a tasting and a tour (maybe you get to see the barrel room if you're lucky). Here? You're crushing grapes. Pressing juice. Tasting straight from your barrel as it ages. The big difference is scale. While other places offer 28-bottle batches, you're making 240 bottles minimum. That's wedding-level volume. Or enough to sell to your friends and family. Some of our winemakers turn their barrels into side businesses. Your wine, your call. First, you'll crush fresh grapes during harvest. 1 Week later, you press the fermented juice (it smells incredible, by the way). Then comes the waiting. Your barrel ages for 11 months. You'll visit to taste. By bottling day, you're not just taking home 240 bottles–you actually understand what you made. Why Merlot softens Cabernet. What oak aging does to tannins. The science behind fermentation. Up to 10 people share a barrel. Split the cost, split the wine. Or...Build your own wine brand and let us support you in a fun and rewarding industry. They taste single varietals blind, argue about the ratios, and blend something together that reflects exactly how they work as a group. Then they bottle it, label it, and take it home. We seat up to 48 for a blending evening, or up to 72 for a walk-around event, and our Hicksville barrel room keeps a steady 55 to 60 degrees year-round. Dusk A fruity, medium-bodied semi-dry St. Pepin with aromas of apple and pear, this wine has a bright, crisp finish. Dusk pairs well with grilled chicken, shrimp, or your favorite fruit pie Open Road A semi-dry white wine, made from Edelweiss grapes. Open Road is named for the popular motorcycle rally held in July. Serenity A refreshing semi-sweet Brianna, this wine has tropical notes, pineapple in particular. Serenity is delicately balanced with a clean finish and pairs well with chicken, white cheeses, and cheesecake. Starlite White A semi-sweet, fragrant Edelweiss that can be enjoyed on any occasion. Starlite White is named for the drive-in movie theatre that operated for many years in the Plum Creek township. FRUIT & ROSÉ Birds-Eye View A refreshing semi-sweet cranberry blend with appealing flavors of pear and apple. Great to drink anytime but it pairs particularly well with your holiday meals. Country Neighbor A semi-sweet apple wine made from fresh pressed apples that have been locally grown. Raspberry Blush - Out of Stock A flavorful blend of local raspberries, Frontenac, and Brianna makes this a refreshing semi-sweet wine. Legendary Berry A sweet wine made from the juiciest of apples and cranberries, it is perfect if you're looking to treat yourself to something tasty. This means 100% of our farming operations are dedicated to growing ingredients for our beer, focusing on acres of malting barley and other grains bred specifically for brewing. We grow the majority of grains we use to make our beer from these acres on our family owned and operated farm. Ingredients Since beer is an agricultural product, we take great care in growing and sourcing ingredients. Our focus is using the finest ingredients available to offer you the highest quality beer we’re capable of making. We use craft malt in our beer. Beyond what we grow here, nearly all of the grain we use comes from small farms in the Piedmont, our agricultural region. Our water comes from a natural source deep below our land. The yeast we use for all of our farmhouse ales is native to Wheatland and was wild-captured in sight of the century old corn crib barn brewhouse. Methods With the highest quality ingredients in hand, our attention turns to the most effective ways to express the character of those ingredients. Our approach is almost never the most cost effective and seldom the most efficient, but we do this to coax from each ingredient its truest flavor expression. For us, this is where the art and science of brewing meet. Land Beer is From Here As an estate brewery that’s Farming for Fermentation, we have the opportunity to create beer unique to Wheatland Spring that reflects the agricultural character of our farm and Piedmont growing region. Due to state restrictions and zoning laws there was no regulations in Connecticut allowing farm distilleries. So, the first step was to contact state representative Jason Perillo to introduce a bill to allow it. After the bill was passed into law the horse barn rebuild and permit applications began in 2018. A long-time cider lover, I have never been satisfied with ciders that are overly sweet and artificial. I wanted to make cider the way my great-grandparents would have enjoyed in back in the motherland. This inspired my quest to learn how to make an additive-free cider that tasted like apples. Golden Row cider is made from nothing but apples from Mt. View’s row of 100-year-old apple trees. Each cider blend starts with a base of apples fresh-pressed on site in a small-craft cidery to achieve a balance of sweetness, tartness, and dryness that everyone loves. After fermentation, the cider is back-sweetened with more fresh-pressed juice. Along with having no extra sugar, Golden Row is naturally gluten free. Visitors to Mt. csj7qcc.title: Sleight of Hand Cellars
csj7qcc.txt: Sleight of Hand Cellars | Sleight of Hand Cellars | Open navigation menu | Close navigation menu | 8R3A9207.jpg | Sleight of Hand Cellars | Keith, Trey, and Jerry | Walla Walla tasting room | Katrina Haus Morales on Facebook | Katrina Haus Morales | Sleight of Hand Cellars | Sleight of Hand Cellars | Sleight of Hand Cellars is a small, family owned winery located in the majestic Walla Walla Valley that focuses on making elegant, thought provoking wines that represent the finest vineyards in Washington State and the Walla Walla Valley. | HOMEVINEYARDSTEAMSHOPWINE CLUBGALLERY TRADEPRESSEVENTSVISITBLOG “Over the past ten years Sleight of Hand Cellars has steadily been evolving every facet of their wine program. They now clearly possess one of the consistently great wine lineups in the Pacific Northwest — everything from crisp, tension-filled Riesling to textured, ultra-pure, red fruit-driven Grenache, inky, complex Bordeaux-inspired wines and one of the most impressive lineups of Rocks District Syrahs that you find anywhere. The result is nothing short of a world-class lineup of wines.” — OWEN BARGREEN, October 2026 “The Sleight of Hand Cellars wines have always been as compelling and full of personality as the vinyl record collection in its tasting rooms. The winery’s recent releases, however, are a giant leap forward in terms of sophistication, detail, and straight-up pleasure. These wines vault Sleight of Hand way up the ladder to the top rungs of Washington’s producers.” — SEAN SULLIVAN, January 2025 “The style at Sleight of Hand, under the guidance of Trey Busch, Jerry Solomon, and Keith Johnson, has changed dramatically over the past 4-5 years and the wines show more finesse, elegance, and purity today, without sacrificing on fruit or texture. These are brilliant wines, and I certainly include this estate in the top handful of estates in Washington today.” – JEB DUNNUCK, April 2019 Serious wines without the serious attitudes... Sleight of Hand Cellars was founded in 2007 by Trey Busch and Jerry and Sandy Solomon. Our only goal from the outset has been to make world class wines while having the most fun that is legally possible. Our love of great wines from around the world, and our love of music, have inspired our vision and growth and have helped us reach a customer base that has the same passions as we do. Since its inception, Sleight of Hand Cellars has been named one of "The Next Generation" of up and coming wineries in Washington State, as well as one of "The Next Cult Wineries" by Seattle Magazine. In addition, we’ve had 3 different wines in the Wine Spectator Top 100 over the past 9 years, including the 2022 Spellbinder, 2015 Levitation and 2016 Archimage. The 2021 Off He Goes Syrah was also featured in the Wine Enthusiast Magazine’s Top 100 Cellar Selections of 2024. “While I've always loved the wines from these guys, they've hit a new level recently, and the wines are now up there with the crème de la crème of the state (and beyond).” - Jeb Dunnuck In 2011 the winery moved from a 900 sq. foot storefront location in DT Walla Walla to its current 10 acre property on JB George Rd. on the southside of the Walla Walla Valley. Here, we continue to focus on making wines that compete with the best in the world, from a combination of estate vineyards and non-estate vineyards around Washington State. Keith Johnson joined our team in 2011 and has been our production winemaker for the past decade. His attention to detail and uncompromising passion for making wine shines through in our offerings. Having Keith in the winery allows Trey to spend more time in the vineyards, ensuring we are delivering the best fruit possible to our winemaking team! Our tasting rooms are something everyone who loves wine and music should experience at least once (and hopefully often). In our Walla Walla location, we have a collection of over 3,000 albums from a wide range of musical genres, with turntables spinning vinyl in all 3 of our tasting rooms. We also have a small vinyl store for you to peruse while enjoying our delicious wines. Our love of ALL music inspires the wines we make (the production facility always has music—usually Seattle’s KEXP radio station--playing) as well as our marketing approach to reach our customers (we have the best winery t-shirts in the business). And our wine club, The Wine Illusionist Society, gets to enjoy our collaboration with one of our favorite music labels, Sub Pop Records in Seattle, because with each shipment we send them the latest and greatest songs on Sub Pop via digital download! We even started a VINE(YL) Club for our wine club members who love the physical format of music! And of course, we host a number of concerts in SODO and in Walla Walla every year! Great wine, great music, and lots of fun—that’s our recipe for the Sleight of Hand lifestyle. Visit a tasting room! Our beer-making mission is a blend of art and science using Colorado mountain water and fresh ingredients. Our craft beer, like the goat, is adventurous, bold and balanced in its environment, and comfortable on the edge. Microbrews & Microbiology | Craft Brewing Science The traditions of craft brewing. The science of microbiology. These two disciplines have united at the base of the Rocky Mountains to create one of Colorado’s fastest-growing beer destinations. Our beers are inspired by the classic styles that have been brewed by people for thousands of years, yet we improve on these brewing techniques with the latest advances in technology and microbiology. Representing Colorado | Award-Winning Beer Every craft beer we produce is designed to provide an extraordinary experience. Whether you are looking for your old standby or looking for something new, our ales and lagers will display the best of what Colorado has to offer. All of the beers at our Fort Collins brewery begin with Colorado water, yeast, and malt because, at the Gilded Goat Brewing Company, we are proud of our state, and we want our beers to showcase what makes Colorado unique. The family behind the Gilded Goat Brewing Company was inspired by European brewing traditions, and by applying the science of microbiology to our brewing technique, we work to produce a high-quality and consistent craft beer. Our taproom also has a rotating selection, depending on season and availability. Meet the brandymen, Keith and Craig. Craig (Mr. W) and Keith (Mr. D) shared a love of Walla Walla wines, the small unique city itself, and an interest in distilling. Mr. W had spent some time in France, and learned to appreciate good brandy. His memory of a glass of cognac after every meal spurred the idea that he and Mr. D could create a quality local craft brandy. Convinced that Washington wines and Walla Walla wines in particular were the best in the world, they looked for the brandy they thought would be distilled from these fine wines. They could not find any craft distillers, so they made the wise decision to make brandy themselves. Hence, DW Distilling was born – located, of course, in Walla Walla! Want to keep up on the latest news from DW? Like us on Facebook or follow us on Instagram! My D (right) and Mr. W (left) tasting some of their fine brandies. We are proud to announce the newest member of the DW family, Mr Nick Spencer. Nick brings with him a level of hospitality and spirits knowledge unmatched by most. As a Partner and Director of Hospitality, he elevates the guest experience and provides another creative to the Brandymen. STAY IN TOUCH, $5 OFF YOUR NEXT PURCHASE About brandy Brandy began as a way to preserve wine. Once distilled, the "spirit" of the wine would last forever, and could then be taken on long voyages. In modern times, typical brandy is made from low-quality wines that are only intended to be distilled. The wine is distilled twice, then blended with caramel and other additives to give it color and taste. But our brandy is made a little differently. First of all, every bottle of DW brandy started with great wine. These incredible wines are already barrel-aged and bottle-ready, so we simply distill them once. This preserves the complexities of the wine and the subtleties of the winemaker's art. Once distilled, we simply barrel-age the brandy until it's ready to bottle. The result is a smooth, complex brandy that highlights all the notes of the original wine. Come visit our tasting room, get a tour, and drink some brandy with us! OUR PRODUCTS BARRACKS BLEND Blended with many different wines, our blend is a perfectly balanced brandy, fit for any occasion. It's as good with an ice cube as it is in a great cocktail. VINTNER'S SELECT Our vintner's select is crafted from one Walla Walla winemaker’s vintage only. One vintner, one vintage, one brandy. This changes constantly giving the palette infinite variety, vintage by vintage. RESERVE Selected for exceptional taste from our finished Vintner’s Select brandies, this blend is racked into larger format neutral barrels for additional aging of 5 years. An XO experience. Steeped in art, history and a sense of place, locations range from neighborhood pubs to historic hotels where live music and history talks are the norm, and soaking pools, movie theaters and other fun prevail. Handcrafted McMenamins Breweries 68,500+ BATCHES AND COUNTING! McMenamins currently operates 24 breweries, with our newest at Elks Temple in Tacoma, Washington. Since our first brew in 1985, McMenamins has produced more than 68,000 batches. DISCOVER OUR BREWERIES Edgefield Winery STOP BY OUR WINERY TASTING ROOM Founded in 1990, our Edgefield Winery crafts a diverse assortment of wines and ciders, all offered throughout McMenamins eclectic neighborhood pubs and gathering spots in Oregon and Washington. DISCOVER OUR WINERY Coffee Roasters STOP BY FOR A CUP O' JOE! McMenamins approaches specialty coffee roasting with the same passion for attention to detail that we apply to our ales, wines and spirits. Our roast masters use only beans from the highest-quality coffea arabica species – plants that produce coffees of elegant, complex flavors. DISCOVER OUR COFFEE Distilleries HANDCRAFTED SPIRITS Both McMenamins distilleries, one at Edgefield in Troutdale, Ore. and the other at Cornelius Pass Roadhouse in Hillsboro, are now producing heavenly spirits of the highest order, from gins to whiskeys to brandies and more. LOCATIONS, RECIPES AND MORE Discover our Art Take a look at the incredible artwork that adorns our walls, ceilings, floors, doors and more at our pubs, breweries and hotels. Who thinks up this stuff? Who creates it? What is the inspiration? Originally, the artwork served a practical purpose – as Mike McMenamin puts it, "We had good-sized walls to cover." But over the course of twenty-plus years, the art evolved into an expression of the building's history, the company's mission and of McMenamins itself. HARD CIDER COLD BEER GOOD VIBES 150 CHATHAM ST UNIT 14 ** TUESDAY IS $5 DRAFT DAY** TAPROOM HOURS TUES-WEDS-THURS 4:00 - 9:00 FRI-SAT 12-9 SUN 12-7 Order now our story The fledgling plans for Steel Town Cider came about as three friends gathered together for a semi regular imbibe while demonstrating their best attempts at backyard culinary prowess over a smouldering charcoal grill steaming with seafood. Like many grand ideas, this one came from thoughts on how to solve a problem. The particular conundrum weighing heavily on their minds throughout this warm late summer afternoon was... Why can’t we get more interesting dry rustic ciders locally, like the many Spanish, French and English bottles we were lucky enough to get while travelling or through an importer from time to time. We saw the craft brewery selection absolutely explode with options and innovations, the wave of emerging natural wine available was steadily gathering momentum, but the aisle in our local monopole of cider was chock full with uninspiring alcoholic pop flavoured with apple. Fast forward a few years, a few hundred espressos, many more meetings and in 2016 the guys were ready to jump in with a solid strategy, a start up location in the beautiful valley area of Dundas in the city of Hamilton, and most of the red tape and licensing complete. The cider style of very dry, slightly sour, funky, mixed yeast fermentations with barrel ageing was always at the core of the procedural essence of Steel Town Cider Co. and developed over the years prier to opening with seasonal garagiste productions. However with the commercial location came a new found opportunity to expand various aspects of production, experiment with techniques being used, establish local apple sources, and progress the product that would become their first release: ‘Session Cider’. c4pz64y.title: Seven Points Brewery | stellapastabar
c4pz64y.txt: Seven Points Brewery | stellapastabar | top of page | IMG_2726.jpeg | | STARWORDS.UPDATE.png | Site | FuzzTrio.png | FuzzTrioFlip.png | 07A6575A-FFA4-4C0F-BA9E-D5FF107A806D.jpg | Site | 7PONLINE.png | | | | | | 5DollaPints.png | | | | Subscribe | Social Bar | White Facebook Icon | White Facebook Icon | White Instagram Icon | White Instagram Icon | bottom of page | Stella Pasta Bar & Bistro | Seven Points Brewery | 237 Union St, Schenectady NY | Upstate | Capital Region | Italian Food | Craft Beer | Seven Points Brewery | stellapastabar | stellapastabar | Home Menus Print Menus Seven Points Brewery Van Dyck Music Club Event Calendar Hours / Contact Us Our Current Line-up: Prima Vista Italian Pilsner 4.9% ABV - 35 IBU The "Italian Pilsner" is a recent innovation in modern brewing history, setting itself apart from its northern counterparts in Germany by the use of a unique dry-hopping process. The goal is not to simply over-hop a traditional German Pils, but rather to craft a subtle space for the traditional European hop varieties to shine along with the rest of the ingredients. For our Italian Pils, we selected 3 different German noble varieties that we use at different times during the brewing process. "Northern Brewer" hops, which are predominantly spicy with an undercurrent of woods and wild fruit. "Tettnanger" hops, bringing a mix of floral, fruity, and herbal notes. And finally, "Saphir" hops, with sweet, fruity overtones, and a hint of dried lemongrass. A simple malt base of light Pilsner malt is accentuated with an addition of "American Honey" malt, bringing a touch of warm, bready, bakery flavors to the beer. The result is a nicely hop-forward, immensely drinkable brew that pairs well with a variety of dishes; from seafood to spicy fried chicken wings. The beer pours crisp and clear, (though it is unfiltered) thanks to our extended cold conditioning process. Stellar Magnitude NE IPA 7.4% ABV - 18 IBU A New England Style IPA, known for its hazy glow, and fruity, hop-forward aromas and flavors. A creamy base of malts ranging from high protein New England grown barley, Red Wheat, and toasted Oat Malt make the perfect place to showcase the hop profiles. Citra hops, one of the most sought after hops in the world, are the predominant focus of this brew, and make up over half of the total hop charge. Citra hops are packed with strong citrus and tropical aromas, and are used on both the hot side in the kettle and whirlpool, and the cold side during fermentation. Mosaic hops are another variety that has intense flavors of tropical pine and stone fruits, carrying aromas akin to a hoppy mango. Finally, we finish with Columbus hops, which have a deep, punchy hop flavor, along with light-herbal and lemon-citrus backnotes. All three hops find their way into our dry hopping schedule, which includes several additions at several different times to maximize their flavors. Fermented with a unique mix of yeast strains to maximize the fruit-forward notes in this brew. Dionysus White Wine Sour Ale *Gold Medal Winner at the New York State Craft Beer Competition - Experimental Beer Category* 9.2% ABV - 5 IBU A pale gold colored, strong sour ale, dosed with white wine grape juice. "Kettle souring" is a method used by brewers where unfermented beer wort stays in the brew kettle over the course of several days at an elevated temperature while select strains of beneficial bacteria cultures create lactic acid and sour the beer. The culture we used results in a simple, bright, and refreshingly fruity acidity, the perfect base for the final addition. Unfermented white wine grape juice is introduced in the late-fermentation stage of the brew, while yeast is still active and looking for additional sugar to eat. This helps increase the final ABV and body of the beer while retaining a high level of flavor from the grapes. The final pour off the taps and into your wine glass is cold, crisp, pleasantly sour, slightly dry, but maintains a sweet grape flavor finish. ​ King's Crown Golden Ale 5.0% ABV - 15 IBU ​ A refreshing, crisp, and easy drinking light ale. American Blonde Ales were born as an alternative to American style lagers, as a way of introducing your typical "mass market" lager drinker into craft beers. Fans of our other lighter Seven Points beers like the Prima Vista Italian Pilsner will find a welcome home in this brew. Medium-bodied, moderately sweet, and with a light hop bitterness, this brew pours light-straw colored from the taps, and finishes dry with a slightly fruity note. Helping the fruit notes along is the sole hop contributor to this brew; Cascade, known for it's citrus, grapefruit, and floral characteristics. The Blonde Ale takes it's place on our tap list as a sure-to-be summer patio favorite, and as both a perfect alternative for anyone who might find our other offerings too hoppy, and as a "gateway" beer for anyone unaccustomed to drinking craft! Baritone American-style Porter 5.5% ABV - 33 IBU ​ Born out of English roots but with a robust American style upgrade, Baritone maintains the drinkability of a more common English Brown Porter, but with the black malt richness and hop character of its American cousin. Several varieties of malt make their way into the mash, ranging from flavorful base malts like Vienna, Munich, and Brown malt, to Honey, Biscuit, and dark Chocolate malts, all of which bring their own unique flavors to the mix. Hopped with a substantial addition of NY grown Cascade to balance the sweetness of the brew and accentuate the bitterness of the dark malts. While clarity can be hard to determine in a beer such as this, when held to the light, a clear, dark brown and garnet color can be seen. A clean fermenting American ale yeast was used to let the malts shine without any fruity esters present. A tan colored head is released upon pouring the brew from the taps, with moderate lacing making its way down the glass. Prost! Voyager WC/NE Hybrid IPA 6.4% ABV - 31 IBU ​ Voyager IPA

AnandaRasa Catawba is a non-profit organization devoted to empowering individuals and strengthening our community by serving others through Yoga, meditation, Satsang, Ayurveda and other facets of the sacred healing arts. Since we began in 2014 as Catawba Farms and then co-created the Catawba Valley Festival of the Arts in 2021, we recognized that collaboration is key to pioneering a broader, more inclusive landscape with the arts serving as a powerful catalyst for Awakening. Explore and engage in our community with Yoga & movement sessions, satsang and events to nurture and advance the creative spirit in your being as we share our being with one another. Welcome! Get 50 free credits Start for free Welcome to Sam Hill Springs Winery FROM OUR HEARTS TO YOUR GLASS Come relax, have some laughs, and enjoy our small batch wines. 2978 Sam Hill Rd., Glenville, PA 17329 MONTHLY SCHEDULE WELCOME Welcome! Sam Hill Springs Winery is a husband and wife run winery. Together we fell in love with wine making and decided to share this joy with others. We hope that you will come give our wines a try! FIND OUT MORE WELCOME: OPEN SCHEDULE September-November Open most Sat. and Sun. 11am-4pm Closed Sept. 19-20 Sept. 26-27 (come see us at Wine Tasting on the Hill) Oct. 24-25 Last Day of the Season Nov. 15 Possible schedule changes can occur. For bottle sales outside of hours, contact us via phone, email, or messenger. PLAN YOUR VISIT ABOUT Our Story Winemaking is a passion for both of us. Although it is not our primary job, we put our hearts into each wine and hope our passion reaches your glass. Rob is the general manager for a small business. Kim is a teacher of over 20 years. We are parents to three children and at times you may find them helping in the vineyard. Our love of wine and wine making began in 2020. We developed a love of wine while spending time with family and friends, and visiting local wineries. Through these years we have developed many friendships that have helped us on this journey! We hope your time with us is an enjoyable journey! Wine Production We craft small batch wines with care and love. The majority of our grape and fruit wines are produced from locally grown and picked fruit. Most of our grape wines are produced from the grapes in our vineyard and from grapes sourced from local vineyards. Our fruit is mainly hand picked on the property. Our batches range from 3-50 gallons depending on the variety. Our Wines Our wines are all small batch wines, so we only craft about 2,000 bottles a year. These small batch wines are only available while they last. Come out and enjoy a bottle! LEARN MORE Our Wines We like to have fun here at Sam Hill Springs Winery. Our wines do too! We have a wide variety of wine selections. Our line of wines range from dry to sweet. We have various white, red, fruit, and blended wines. Come out for a tasting to try a few! LEARN MORE PLAN YOUR VISIT Visiting Welcome! We are open many Saturdays and Sundays from 11-4. Please be sure to check the monthly schedule above, check our website, and/or check our Facebook page before visiting. The last tasting for the day is at 4. The schedule is subject to change . Our winery is located at our home. Upon arriving walk on the gravel pathway around the back side to the slider door. We have a small tasting room inside. We will do our best to accommodate everyone who visits. When the weather warms up, we have an outside seating area for your enjoyment. Large groups (6 or larger) please contact us directly by email, messenger, or phone. We apologize, but we cannot accept buses and large vehicles at this time. Accessibility Please contact us for your accessibility needs. If you are unable to get down the path to the door or get to the outside seating area, give us a call. If you need assistance, we will do our best to accommodate your needs. Parking Park in the grass next to the stone pathway or in front of the vineyard. Please do not park in front of the garages. Food and Beverages No outside alcoholic beverages. You are welcome to bring your own food to enjoy at the outside seating area or at one of indoor tables. You are welcome to bring your own chairs or a blanket to enjoy the outdoor setting as well when the weather is warm. We do not currently serve any food. Children We understand that parents like an outing too! If you are stopping by with a child please keep them within arms distance and be careful when near the vineyard. Please do not pick the fruit, hang on the wires, or play near the vines. No throwing objects as they can knock the fruit off the vines. We greatly appreciate your understanding! Pets We love animals, but due to limited space and our friendly dog on premises, we ask that dogs remain outside. Please remember to clean up after your pet (if a doggie bag is needed don't hesitate to ask). Service animals are welcome inside, but if you hear barking from our friendly pup don't be alarmed. Smoking No smoking or vaping inside the winery. When smoking outside, please be considerate of other guest. Please discard your butt in the metal container. Thank you for your courtesy. Located in a lovely 19th Century restored Dutch Colonial barn, we pride ourselves on quality and value of service Our Wines Producing a wide variety of wines for over thirty years. We are sure to have something to satisfy everyone from the casual wine sipper to any seasoned wine drinker. Our Spirits Made in a traditional copper pot still in house, Six Mile Creek has been producing spirits for almost a decade. Including Vodka, Gin, and a full line of Italian inspired delights and the best part, they're all made from wine! WINNER OF THE 2019 NY GOVERNORS CUP Six Mile Creek Vineyard from the Finger Lakes region took home the most prestigious award of the competition, The Governor’s Cup, with their 2016 Cabernet Franc. The Governor’s Cup recognizes the “Best of Show” or top prize in the New York Wine Classic. Known as "The Oscars" of New York wine competitions, the New York Wine Classic is open to the more than 458 wineries across the state. The wine competition took place over three days in Watkins Glen, NY and included 883 entries from 113 wineries from across the state. A total of 31 Double Gold, 56 Gold, 287 Silver, and 320 Bronze medals were awarded by a panel of more than 20 expert judges from around the state and globe. For general inquires please see our F.A.Q. ca34jkc.txt: About | Peace Water Winery | Close | CashApp | Apple Pay | Google Pay | Visa | Mastercard | American Express | Discover | JCB | Peace Water Winery logo | Customer account | Cart icon | Open menu | | Peace Water Winery logo | CashApp | Apple Pay | Google Pay | Visa | Mastercard | American Express | Discover | JCB | About | Peace Water Winery | Peace Water Winery | | LOCATIONS PRIVATE EVENTS OUR WINEMAKER OUR WINES KITCHEN MENU MORE OUR STORY ONE BOTTLE DOES A WORLD OF GOOD My wife Laura is the kindest person I know. Somehow she has enough love in her heart to raise eight children, three dogs, two horses, two cats and even an orphaned cow. Despite all the organized chaos, she still finds a way to think of others... whether it is volunteering at schools, running a soup kitchen, or just practicing random acts of kindness. It was a typical crazy weekend (six basketball games, four soccer matches, and an equestrian event) spent scrambling from one place to another in our 1966, 21-window Volkswagen "hippie van." We squeezed in a stop at our local Starbucks drive-thru and, as was her tradition, Laura paid for the double chocolate chip frappuccino the car behind us had ordered. The kids all smiled as they watched the joyous reaction of the lucky recipient. That's when I realized we needed to do something more. What better way to do it than to share great wine with you! If the simple act of buying a stranger a cup of coffee can make someone's day, what can happen if we really set our minds to making a difference. So while our family is large, our vision is larger. We truly believe the smallest act of kindness has a ripple effect that can help change the world. 50% of our net profits will be donated to charity, both locally and across the world. Enjoy our wine knowing every sip is helping make this world a better place! PEACE OUT! With a focus on community and small-batch brewing, Old 690 offers a cozy, rustic setting where visitors can enjoy a variety of beers brewed on-site, including IPAs, stouts, porters, and seasonal offerings. The company initially produced apple and pear brandies, using excess fruit from the valley’s abundant harvests. Over the years, Hood River Distillers expanded its product range to include a diverse array of spirits such as vodka, gin, rum, and whiskey, inspired by the beautiful Pacific Northwest. Today, Hood River Distillers continues to uphold its tradition of quality craftsmanship while embracing innovation. With a portfolio that includes award-winning spirits, the distillery remains a testament to the determination and passion of its founders, earning its place as a beloved and respected name in the spirits industry. Located along the Columbia River with majestic Mt. Hood as its backdrop, Hood River Distillers has been at its current bottling facility in Hood River since 1969. NORTH PARK INSTAGRAM FACEBOOK BEER WITH INTENT creativity. innovation. tradition. independence. collaboration. passion We brew premium quality beers across a broad range of styles and flavors. From classic ESB’s to new school ales, lagers & experimental beers, we believe tradition and innovation can coexist. We create everything in the spirit of collaboration, innovation, independence and tradition. We brew beers that we want to make, & drink, as brewers, as beer lovers, and as advocates of exceptional beer. Our beers have soul, passion, pride & meaning, which we believe comes through in the finished product. We draw inspiration from life, art, culture, experiences & our peers. We brew for our friends, our neighbors, our community, our family, and for strangers. And we brew for ourselves. It is our art. It is our love and passion. OUR BREWERY & EATERY IN SAN DIEGO After founding one of San Diego’s longest standing craft beer bars, Kevin and Kyle Conover expanded operations to North Park with ground-floor built brewery and restaurant. In 2022 TRBC brought on former head brewer of Mikkeller, Daniel Cady, as head brewer of TRBC. With years of experience brewing a wide range of styles as well as numerous awards under his barrel aging program, Cady brings a both technical prowess and a level of creativity that creates for a very unique skillset. TapRoom Beer Company is a multi-level, 5,000 square-feet brewery & restaurant featuring 50 taps, a diverse American fare menu, and rotating guest beer from local independent brewers. We are a neighborhood establishment obsessed with creating world class beers on a small scale level. Our restaurant is full service and features a large dog friendly patio, perfect for those sunny San Diego days. Stop by on the weekends for brunch, or in the afternoon where you’re likely to find Bill sipping a beer after a long brew day (in which case you should totally chat it up with him, the nicest guy you’ll meet). All of our staff are cicerone certified and pride themselves on education, so don’t be afraid to ask questions! Bring your friends & family (yes, we’re kid friendly) and come see us for world class beer, great food, and a good time! We also offer packaged beer to go, as well as limited distribution to some of our favorite beer establishments around town. Stop by, give us a call, or order online! THE STORY – About the “TapRoom” brand – TapRoom was founded in 2006 by San Diego Natives Kyle & Kevin Conover. Growing up in the emerging San Diego beer scene, brothers took their passion and industry experience and created the first craft beer bar that focused exclusively on local San Diego craft breweries. Since 2006 TapRoom has served up local craft beer paired with elevated pub fare in a casual welcoming neighborhood environment. “Our goal was to create a longstanding neighborhood establishment that would serve the community and promote San Diego craft beer”. We are Vito and Guido Vino… “Brothers of the Grape” and best friends for over 60 years. Two Amigos is a boutique winery creating gold medal wines at our Estate in the hills of Sonoma Valley. Our wines are made with uncompromising passion and presented to you with a trace of humor and a bit of irreverence. Our City of Sonoma Tasting room has now been upgraded and moved to our winery in Glen Ellen. We invite you to experience a very memorable private Tour and Tasting by appointment (Just call or email). Click on the “Private Tours” cork at the top of this page. Come Sniff, Sip and Giggle with us! MORE ABOUT US TWO AMIGOS 2026 CROATIA WINE CLUB ADVENTURE Prev Prev Spring Pick Up Party Video Kenwood Press Read Squire’s monthly Kenwood Press column: “JOURNEY TO HARVEST … AND BEYOND” KENWOOD PRESS Two Amigos Wines Video Gallery Experience the hilarious antics of Vito and Guido as they share moments of wine, wit, and laughter VIDEOS Notizie dalla Famiglia (News from the Family) Delicious recipes and updates from the winery & vineyard NEWSLETTERS Poppin’ Bottles OUR WINES 2025 TIRARE IL DITO In March of 2024 this wine won Double Gold, Best of Class and 98 points at the Sonoma International Film Festival wine competition. A seamless, inspired blend of both Estate Syrah and Estate Cabernet Sauvignon. The judge commented…”The best Syrah/Cabernet blend I have ever had from California.” Then he said, “The only other Shiraz (Syrah) & Cabernet blend I would find comparable would be the 1976 Penfold’s Grange.” That wine got a 96 from him. He gave OUR wine a 98! 2025 TWO AMIGOS ESTATE SYRAH Our flagship wine is made from 100% Estate Syrah grapes sourced from our upper vineyard. This unctous, fruit drives, mouth-watering wine is velvety layer cake of blackberry pie, cassis and Bluberries, with notes of mocha, espresso and vanilla. We aged this wine in 30% new French oak. 2025 ESTATE VINO ROSATO A crisp, dry French style Syrah Rose that pairs with any appetizer on the planet! This wine exudes lovely aromas of wild strawberries, fresh raspberries & pink grapefruit. Very food friendly and the only wine I serve at Thanksgiving. Pairs nicely with green beans, yams, turkey, ham and whatever else is on your table. VIEW ALL WINES Love this place! Love this wine! Love the owners! If you want a superb Wine Country experience, look no further! You won't want to miss this. Give them a call, they'll accommodate you. Don't wast your time on typical tourist stops. Us six local girls with lots of winery experience gives this our vote of highest approval! JEANNIE C. csl4hcs.txt: Sugarbush Vineyards | | Sugarbush Vineyards Winery & Vineyard Experience our passion Home Contact Subscribe Buy Wine POS Software Facebook Instagram TikTok Trip Advisor Sugarbush Vineyards is a family owned (Robert & Sally Peck) and operated vineyard and winery located in Prince Edward County, Ontario, Canada. We specialize in small lot, artisanal wines made from our estate-grown grapes. Current: Open Saturday and Sunday 11am - 5pm.. Our 2km trail is open for walking/hiking during store hours. Test your knowledge of local, nature, and maple syrup trivia while walking the trail with 24 fun questions. Tastings are being done in our heated indoor space. As the weather warms up we will be transitioning to our outdoor tasting area. Reservatons are not required, but we can take reservations for larger groups. Seating is first come, first served. Well behaved dogs are welcome. Please have them on a leash. Cheese plates (17$), JW Farm Dips ($15), and Chips and Salsa (8$) are available for purchase. Tastings are offered in a flight of 3 (x 3/4 oz samples) for 6$, or a flight of 4 (x 3/4 oz samples) for 8$, or a flight of 5 (x 3/4 oz samples) for 10$ Kingston/Brockville/Ottawa loop next delivery date: every 2-3 weeks. Cobourg/GTA loop next delivery date: every 2-3 weeks. Local (Belleville/Trenton/The County) deliveries: daily. A brief overview of 2026's event schedule: Jan-Feb: Snowshoeing (weather permiting) Feb 13-16th: Family day weekend with special snack menu March wknds: Maple Madness all month long. Witness syrup production and hike our trail. March 14-15th: Elevage wine festival. May 30th: Dogs days at Sugarbush. A day dedicated to our furry friends. Walk our trail. Vendors with dog treats and accessories on-site. July daily: Gourmet grilled cheese July 5th: Live music July 24th: Happy hour trail run (6.5km). Register at Dirty Soles Trail Running Aug daily: Gourmet grilled cheese Aug 2nd: Live music. Sept 5th: Corn roast and live music. Sept 6th: Corn roast and live music. Sept 19-20th: Sugarbush Shenanigans. A 6, 12, or 24 hour ultra-running experience. Register at Dirty Soles Trail Running Oct 4th: Harvest Brigade. Oct 11th: Harvest Brigade. Nov/Dec: Wassail Our goal is to produce small quantities of hand-crafted premium-quality wines sourced entirely from our vineyard. We start producing premium wines in our vineyard where we limit grape yields to 2 - 2.5 tonnes/acre. Our total production varies year-to-year, but we tend to produce between 2400 - 3000 cases now that our vineyard is in its prime. Our wines are only available at our retail store, a select number of restaurants, and at various LCBO stores in South/Eastern Ontario. Our vineyard is 13 acres (5+ hectares) of vinifera varietials: Cabernet Franc, Gamay, Pinot Noir, Chardonnay, Riesling, Gewürztraminer, and Viognier. We established an 8.5 acre vineyard in 2002 and 2003. Additional acres were planted in 2012, 2015, and 2017. We had our first harvest in the fall of 2006 and opened our winery retail store in September 2007. Sugarbush Vineyards was picked for our vineyard/winery name, as the back 6-7 acres of our 48 acre property contains sugar Maples. This page was last updated: Tuesday November 17th, 2026

This is a "Winery", not a "Bar"... There are up to 18 unique wines offered with all tastings, and "reserve" wines are occasionally offered. Shannon's wines will be unlike any wines sold in stores~ We do not offer wine "by the glass," nor will we pour the same sample twice. Guidelines: 1. The wine studio is limited to reservations, which ensures the finest, exclusive experience for guests... There's a valid reason we limit to six(6) guests in the studio. If you arrive with 'extra' guests without prior approval, we may not have an extra stool, so reach out to express your intent and discuss suitable options. Unlike many wineries, we specialize in a unique tasting experience for guests who want to explore something different. NOTE: While "Non-drinkers" are welcome, each of the six stools is intended to generate revenue. We simply do not have enough seating to guarantee a place setting for "dry" guests... 2. Children are allowed, but some guests find this unique experience more 'flavorable' without the 'distraction' of the underage, and this includes pets. 3. Food options cannot be prepared and available for same-day or last-minute reservations. We make the grocery run 12-24 hours before your reservation. 4. An average tasting session lasts 1 Hour, starting at the appointed time. This allows about 0:15 minutes to conclude business and prepare for our next guests. Please, as a courtesy, help us stay on schedule in the studio and free up space in the limited parking lot... Group Events: As a small craft winery with a 'staff-of-one' and limited time options, we can no longer offer space for group events; showers, birthday parties, weddings, etc... Likewise, we do not offer wine by the glass. Parking: We have only 4 parking spaces. Please share your ride (when possible) and remember that other guests may be scheduled after you and waiting for a parking space... Communications: Shannon is 'deaf'~ Voicemails are futile; text works best. Please set your phone to "Airplane mode" inside the studio. The 30% Non-Refundable Online Security Deposits will be applied to the total balance, which must be paid in cash at the conclusion of the tasting. Bring enough cash with you~ If something unexpected comes up and it's too late to reschedule, send Shannon a text, and we'll find the best solution~ [NOTE: After you secure an appointment online, before you 'cancel' your slot and lose your deposit, it may be better if you log in and reschedule for a later date.] Do Not leave a Voicemail for the deaf- Text only- 803-429-4003 Listed hours on Google are not accurate - If you have a reservation, I'm 'open' for your reservation~ If you don't have a reservation, you can text for availability... The winery has a spectacular panoramic view of the northern Mohawk Valley Region. From East to West the breathtaking scenery will be sure to please as the seasons unfold. Brimfield Farm has been in the Hughes family for 100 years. The farm was purchased in October of 1918 by Richard and Nina Hughes. Upon Richard's retirement, his son Bud operated the farm until 1982. John and Patricia have operated and maintained the farm since 1982. We invite you to visit our century old barn and take a walk back in time in our most intimate setting. Our Barn Come visit us for a tasting in our historic barn hayloft. Consider having your next small gathering or work session of up to 30 guests in our cozy and inviting mezzanine. Brimfield Farm Winery in Clinton, NY offers a pleasant change from the norm. Our family winery is conveniently located just minutes from New Hartford and Utica. Contact us for pricing and details. Our Wines Brimfield Farm Winery is working closely with a highly respected estate winery in the Finger Lakes region to create wines that run from sweet to dry in both red and white. We are confident that there is wine that will please the most scrutinizing palate. Last day of the 2026 season is Sunday, October 25th You can contact us in the off season for your customized gift baskets, gift cards or favorite wine! Cheers! cliya9o.txt: Home | Relative Risk Brewing Company, LLC | Close | CashApp | Apple Pay | Google Pay | Visa | Mastercard | American Express | Discover | JCB | Open menu | Relative Risk Brewing Company, LLC logo | Search | Customer account | Cart icon | Search | Close search | | What a weekend. What a ride. What a family. We’re still feeling all the emotions after this unforgettable, bittersweet weekend. Closing the taproom doors was extremely hard - but the outpouring of love, laughter, and support from all of you made it so much sweeter. From longtime regulars to brand new faces, you filled the place with warmth, stories, and the kind of energy that reminds us why we fell in love with this crazy adventure in the first place. Thank you for showing up, for cheering us on, for every hug, high-five, and shared pint. You’ve become more than customers - you’re lifelong friends, and part of the Relative Risk story forever. While this chapter has closed, we’re far from done. We still plan to keep brewing and can’t wait to share what’s next. Please continue to follow along - the next round’s just getting started. With endless gratitude and love, The Relative Risk Family #RelativeRiskBrewing #RiskTakers #FingerLakes #FLX #SenecaLake #PennYan #GenevaNY #TurnThePage #Grateful | Yesterday’s love was something else. Thank you for showing up big with hugs, laughs, full plates, and prize-winning energy that left us absolutely speechless (and definitely a little emotional). Today, the sun’s out, the games are on, the firepits are rippin', and it feels like the universe knew we needed one perfect last hurrah. It’s a prime Sunday Funday setup - football on the screens, cold beers in hand, free food and prizes, and the playground packed with happy kids and four-legged sidekicks living their best lives. We couldn’t have dreamed up a better way to wrap this up here - surrounded by our people, our pups, and the place that started it all. Thank you for every ounce of love, support, and fun you’ve poured into this taproom. Here’s to soak | Home Tap List Calendar of Events Gift cards Book Your Event WHAT'S LIFE WITHOUT A LITTLE RISK? At Relative Risk Brewing, we believe the boldest beers come from the freshest ideas—and ingredients. That’s why we brew with homegrown and locally sourced fruits, hops and grains, crafting award-winning beer right here on 12 beautiful acres overlooking Seneca Lake. Our space is designed for full-day hangs, with a playground for the kids, a fenced-in dog park for your four-legged companions, and plenty of room to spread out, kick back, and enjoy. Our Mission To craft top-quality beer using local ingredients while creating a laid-back, family-friendly environment where our community can gather, connect, and stay a while. Whether you're here for the beer or the views (or both), we’re proud to serve up good times and fresh picnic lunches to go with it. Our Vision To be a pillar of the Finger Lakes community—where excellence in craft meets everyday comfort. We’re here for the families, the adventurers, and the risk-takers who believe the best memories start with a pint and a place to share it. Because at Relative Risk Brewing, the biggest risk is not stopping by. Taproom Hours Monday: Closed Tuesday: Closed Wednesday: Closed Thursday: 4-8 pm Friday: 4-8 pm Saturday: 12-8 pm Sunday: 12-5 pm Updated Thursday, November 6. Stay tuned for changes. Cheers! THUMB KNUCKLE BREWING COMPANY EST. 2017 Thumb Knuckle Brewing Company opened March 18, 2017 in Luxemburg, WI, just outside of Green Bay and is named “Thumb Knuckle” because of its location on the map. Wisconsin looks like a hand, and the brewery is located on the “knuckle” at the base of the “thumb”. Sticking with this homeland pride, nearly all our ingredients are sourced locally, and the brewing equipment is made from repurposed dairy equipment that was once used on local dairy farms in the area. Ed Thiry is the Brewmaster. While studying mechanical engineering at MSOE, Ed focused on the brewing process as much as possible for projects. It was then that his dream of opening his own brewery began. He moved to Hamburg, Germany to obtain his master’s degree in Renewable Energy Systems, then worked in Lübeck, Germany as a project manager to install wind farms across Europe for 3 years. Wanting to focus on brewing beer and opening the brewery, Ed began his studies through Weihenstephan towards becoming a Brewmaster in Germany. He completed an 18-month internship in a little brewery in Bavaria called the Brauereigenossenschaft Taufkirchen and is proud to brew in the German style for great drinkability. Prost! INTIMATE. COMFORTABLE. Welcome to Sylvan Valley Lodge & Cellars Here, in the gorgeous mountains of North Georgia, colors are vibrant, the air is fresh, and sunsets are simply magical. At Sylvan Valley Lodge & Cellars, you have options. Savor an incredible glass of craft wine or beer by the cozy tasting room fireplace. Explore the serene gardens, abundant with native plantings and mountain views. Discover new experiences. It's your getaway, relax and enjoy it! Sylvan is nestled at the foothill of Yonah Mountain and only 5 minutes from Helen, which is a bustling alpine village that will make you feel like you have been transported to the cobblestone streets of Germany. Colorful shops dot the landscape, and the heavenly aroma of authentic German fare takes to the breeze. Sylvan Valley Lodge is also located close to the Chattahoochee River, which boasts the best trout fishing in the North Georgia mountains. Whatever brings you to our lodge, it is sure to be the most memorable part of your trip. We also provide our guests with a variety of vacation packages and specials, perfect for those planning a romantic getaway in Georgia. Whether you’re looking for a Georgia Wine Country hotel near Alpine Helen, or a relaxing mountain retreat, Sylvan Valley Lodge & Cellars is the perfect escape. We look forward to hosting you. Explore Helen, Georgia Just minutes from the charm of Sylvan Valley Lodge and Cellars, the Bavarian-inspired village of Helen, Georgia, invites you to explore its storybook streets, unique shops, and riverside trails. Whether you're tubing down the Chattahoochee, sipping craft brews, or enjoying seasonal festivals, Helen offers a perfect blend of adventure and old-world charm—all nestled in the stunning North Georgia mountains. Try a different browser. At Lost Abbey, we believe great beer is a creative act—that is defined by art, crafted through devotion resulting in a shared experience. Our beers are contemplative companions, brewed with reverence for those who came before us and those who gather with us now. In Illa Brettanomyces Nos Fides Explore Lost Abbey beers Find your sanctuary in every pour A Higher Order of Brewing Our devotion to the craft has earned international recognition. Beers like Duck Duck Gooze, Carnevale, and Devotion have been celebrated on the world’s biggest stages, while our co-founder Tomme Arthur received the Russell Scherer Award for Brewing Innovation, one of the highest honors in American brewing. These awards are milestones, not the mission—markers along a longer path of craft, creativity, and brewing for sinners and saints alike. About The Lost Abbey Stories from the Abbey October 20, 2026 Tomme’s 30th Anniversary and… Read more → June 11, 2026 Please welcome to The Lost Abbey Hospitality Family The Monastery. Make the Vista Pilgrimage The Sanctuary - San Marcos Peace be with brew. Nestled in the hills of North County, The Sanctuary offers a serene escape from the noise of the world. This family-friendly refuge is where locals gather to share food, stories, and fresh pours under the open sky. A place to slow down, connect, and celebrate life’s simpler sacraments. Food trucks Wed-Sun. Make the San Marcos Pilgrimage The Monastery - Miralani District A place for quiet contemplation and exceptional beer. Nestled within the Miralani Makers' District, The Monastery offers a more contemplative side of The Lost Abbey experience. Inspired by the warmth of an English pub, this intimate gathering place invites guests to settle into a sofa, challenge a friend to darts, and linger over thoughtfully crafted beers. Make the Miralani District Pilgrimage The Confessional - Cardiff Where the faithful come to confess their thirst. A short walk from the ocean, The Confessional is equal parts coastal hideaway and spiritual experience. The confessional booth invites beachgoers and believers alike to unburden themselves over a pint. Here, every sip is an act of repentance—best followed by another. Make the Cardiff Pilgrimage The Church - San Diego Raise your glass beneath vaulted shadows. Experience the best Lost Abbey has to offer. Our large deck is perfect for events at Petco. Doggos Gus provides TJ Style Dogs and Smash Burgers. Hang Out. Crafted for the Cohort Two Brews with Views See What’s Hoppin’ Welcome to Cohort Craft Brewery. We’re your neighborhood Black Hills brewery with not one, but two spots to sip: Rapid City and Hill City. We’re pouring bold craft beer, mead on tap for the curious and crisp NA beverages. Come thirsty, leave converted. And remember to share a drink with the locals whenever possible. Not Your Average Brewery. Not Even Close. Two sites, two vibes: One in Rapid City with a neighborhood feel. One out side of Hill City with Black Hills views for days. Mead matters: The only Black Hills brewery that always has mead on tap. Sweet, bold, and totally underrated. Made with 100% local honey. Freshness on repeat: Our small batch breweries keep our beer flowing and the turnover snappy. No stale sips here. Staff-powered: Our craft crew doesn’t just pour beer – they brew it. Expect wildcards, one-offs, and passion projects on tap. Fuel up at both locations: Rotating Food Trucks and the Prairie Dog both serve it up just right because great beer deserves great grub. From Home to Black Hills Brews We built Cohort to be more than a brewery—it’s your brewery, too. Limited distribution, no middlemen—just fresh beer, brewed in-house and poured feet from where it’s made. Our Rapid City spot feels like your neighborhood hangout, while Hill City’s all about mountain views and post-hike pints. With full tanks, open doors, and a team that brews their own creations, we’re crafting more than beer—we’re crafting experience. Customer Reviews What a cool establishment. The beer is delicious, several options and even a few guest beers! The Deli is also convenient and well priced, and yummy. The grounds are spacious, dogs welcome, as well as kids, and they have corn hole, bocce ball, fire pits and lots of tables. This is a real family establishment and a great spot to stop into! Excited to see how this grows! Jessica Patel Very comfortable setting. Met friends there.. was able to have a conversation at the table. There is a QR code on the table to order food and they send a text message when the food is ready. Pet friendly atmosphere Trisha Shoaf Being stuck with the gluten allergy, its hard to go out with friends and enjoy drinks and conversation, without being stuck drinking a seltzer. Just tried the Cranberry Hibiscus Meade, it was incredibly delicious and rather refreshing. Thank you Cohort for offering a variety of gluten free options. Thomas Leaman If you're not familiar, disregard the complaint from PG. This is one of the best breweries in SD. It is their 4 year anniversary today and all things considered it really isn't that busy. Oh and the oysters are fantastic! And as always, Amanda and Mel are slaying it!! Bryce Grote This place is awesome. We aren't local and out of the three local breweries we visited this is the one we returned to the last night of our trip. Employees are so friendly, my boyfriend really enjoyed the IPAs, and I loved the sours! Clean, good atmosphere and they have a game we played for like an hour (dingo disk). Shayna I'm from Colorado and the beer and atmosphere were fantastic. Everyone who has a chance should stop by Cohort craft brewery is the real deal! The staff was very knowledgeable and helpful. Especially the nice and friendly tattooed CrossFit lady. Abbie? And Becky! Raymond Glover Came here for a work party. Relaxed atmosphere. Clean. Starwars pinball was a blast. Try your hand at the Dingo Disk game with some friends. Keller beer was killer. My coworkers enjoyed all their beers as well. Great hang 👍 Hunter Clark This place is pretty great. Nice open outdoor space in the back with bocce and cornhole, lots of tables, audible but not too loud music (sometimes old school vinyl), good crowd, and good beer selection. A lot of IPA but also a decent mead and some other options. Definitely recommend a stop here for a relaxing afternoon. Justin Wade I can't say enough about how much we enjoyed the great beers and food. Lovely facility inside and out. There was a glitch with our RV reservation but the staff went above and beyond to fix the problem. Truly top notch individuals. Nestled in the Texas Hill Country, Pilot Knob Vineyard takes its name from a prominent volcanic formation that rises from the landscape just miles away. This ancient landmark lends the vineyard not only its identity but also a sense of place that is deeply rooted in the region's geology and history. Perched along a gentle ridge, the property offers sweeping views of rolling hills, native oaks, and carefully tended vines that stretch toward the horizon. Handcrafted and thoughtfully produced, the wines of Pilot Knob Vineyard reflect the personality of the Hill Country itself. The portfolio spans a range of styles, from bright and approachable whites to structured, expressive reds, each made with an emphasis on balance and purity of fruit. Whether you favor something crisp and refreshing or prefer a wine with more weight and complexity, there is a bottle here to suit the occasion. Every glass poured is an invitation to explore the flavors that this distinctive terroir can yield. A visit to the tasting room offers more than just a flight of wines. Steeped in art, history and a sense of place, locations range from neighborhood pubs to historic hotels where live music and history talks are the norm, and soaking pools, movie theaters and other fun prevail. Handcrafted McMenamins Breweries 68,500+ BATCHES AND COUNTING! McMenamins currently operates 24 breweries, with our newest at Elks Temple in Tacoma, Washington. Since our first brew in 1985, McMenamins has produced more than 68,000 batches. McMenamins approaches specialty coffee roasting with the same passion for attention to detail that we apply to our ales, wines and spirits. LOCATIONS, RECIPES AND MORE Discover our Art Take a look at the incredible artwork that adorns our walls, ceilings, floors, doors and more at our pubs, breweries and hotels. Who thinks up this stuff? Who creates it? What is the inspiration? Originally, the artwork served a practical purpose – as Mike McMenamin puts it, "We had good-sized walls to cover." But over the course of twenty-plus years, the art evolved into an expression of the building's history, the company's mission and of McMenamins itself. Since 2022, we have been farming our own 10 acres in Prairie Valley using organic practices. Our estate vineyard is home to varieties suited to our site, including Leon Millot, Gewürztraminer, Pinot Gris, Seyval Balnc, Chardonnay and Pinot Noir. All vineyard work is done by hand, with a focus on soil health and low-input farming. Fermentations occur spontaneously with native yeast, and wines are made without additions, managing spoilage with sulphites only. We do not fine or filter. Each wine reflects the growing season and the fruit as it arrives at the cellar, nothing more and nothing less. As a small garagiste winery, we work in small lots and allow each grape variety and vintage to guide the process. Seasonal shifts and natural variability bring differences to the wines each year, and we lean into those changes to express our valley’s character as clearly as possible. Tastings are complimentary, and visitors are welcome to stop by and learn more about our vineyard, our methods, and the wines we produce. Mr. Solla crafted his first bottle of wine when he was gifted a home wine making kit from his daughter in 2001. Having enjoyed the experience and the resulting beverage, John took up winemaking in his home as a hobby. Over the next several years, he experimented and perfected the art of producing a delicious, refreshing bottle of wine. On a business trip in 2007, Mr. Solla decided that he needed a change from the series of restaurants he was managing in the West Texas area. He filed for the appropriate licenses, put a deposit down on a store front, and created this now successful and well-known venture: Homemade Wines, LLC. Appropriately named Homemade Wines, all wine is fermented, mixed, bottled and labelled in house. The notorious oil-patch themed names were inspired by a deep love and appreciation of this Permian Basin community. In 2020, John and Vicki started looking at moving closer to their grandchildren, so they passed the torch of the Homemade Wines dynasty to local West Texan couple Kris and Kira Boen. Visit Gatehouse Winery for premium wines and picturesque landscape views. THE GATEHOUSE WINERY AT PYMATUNING Glop! Pop! Yes, that amazing sound that is created when the cork is removed too fast. Although a sommelier prefers a silent cork removal with a slow twist at the last second, we have come to appreciate the fantastic sound of a cork popping out of a bottle. To us at Gatehouse Winery, when you hear the bottle open, it's more than a sound. We know you are among new or old friends who came together to share a bottle of wine and create a memory. From the first sip to the next, story after story, laughter and joy flow from your table, filling the room. From the first bottle popping at Gatehouse Winery, you can create lifelong memories. Leashed pets are permitted on the patio! | Railshake | Railshake | Serving many made-from-scratch recipes and sauces, along with locally sourced steaks that are hand cut in-house, Railshake's focus is to bring the freshness and quality of a homemade meal into a fine casual dining experience. Inside, we offer a full menu with table and bar seating. During warmer months, we open our beautiful patio, where guests may enjoy drinks and a limited food menu. Now, you can enjoy your favorites from home with online ordering! CLICK HERE TO ORDER ONLINE We will derail your tastebuds! Inside, enjoy our comfortable dining area, or pull up a stool at the bar. You'll love the ice rail, and our top-of-the-line draft system, featuring 18 specialty craft beers from many local breweries! If you're 21+, pull up a seat in our gaming area. Outside, weather-permitting, relax on our 3-season patio overlooking the tracks. Our patio serves a limited menu and hosts live music, shrimp boils, and other events. As always, leashed pets are welcome on our patio! Burgers, jambalaya, pasta, and everything in between. Enjoy Railshake for lunch or dinner. Our menu and specials include variety of dishes from American to Cajun/Creole. A “must try” is Teffy’s Famous Homemade Remoulade. That stuff is delicious on her Spicy Chicken Wraps! At Tiger Mountain Vineyards, we believe exceptional wine begins in the soil and is shaped by the hands that honor it. Nestled high in the Blue Ridge Mountains, our estate has become one of Georgia’s most acclaimed vineyards, celebrated for crafting wines that reflect both place and purpose. Guided by a commitment to elevated terroir, artisanal precision, and sustainable stewardship, each bottle tells a story of balance, intention, and connection. Our winemaker, recognized among Wine Enthusiast’s Future 40 Tastemakers of 2025, leads a program that has earned numerous awards and accolades—yet our greatest achievement remains the experience we create: an invitation to slow down, savor deeply, and share in something enduring. Explore Our Wines Shop online to explore some of our favorite wines Petit Manseng A full bodied and aromatic white. Aged in French Oak for 9 months, yet it is very fruit forward, with hints of pineapple, guava, vanilla, and subtle florality. This wine went through partial malolactic fermentation resulting in a round and soft mouthfeel which leads to a lengthy finish. BUY NOW Rabun Red This classic estate blend consists of Norton, Cabernet Franc, and Tannat. Oak aged for 30 months in French and American oak. Dominated by aromas of strawberry, boysenberry, licorice, and toasted hazelnut with a touch of vanilla. BUY NOW White Tiger This elegant white is a blend of Viognier and Petit Manseng. The Viognier was aged in stainless steel while the Petit Manseng was aged in French oak for 6 months. In this medium bodied blend you may notice notes of pear, apricot, lime zest, and almond which leads to a balanced and silky finish. BUY NOW Mountain Cyn Our Mountain Cyn is a full-bodied blend of Norton and Cabernet Franc. Characterized by notes of blackberry, bright red cherry, mushroom, fresh earth, dark red apple, black currant, and toasted oak. Using old-world techniques and sourcing ingredients from the local orchards and fresh water springs of Mount Hood in the Oregon countryside, Clear Creek became one of the first craft distilleries in the United States. CLEAR (UNAGED) BRANDIES The clear fruit brandies of France also known as eau de vie, which translates to “water of life”. Most European countries have a local term for the clear, bone-dry brandies distilled from the regional fruit. Usually bottled at around 80 proof, these spirits are typically served at the end of a meal, or between courses, as the perfect digestif. These fruit brandies are traditionally un-aged to maintain the wonderful intensity of the fruit. The heart of Clear Creek’s product line is our fruit brandies, which are all made according to old world techniques traditionally used in Europe. We use only pure, whole Pacific Northwest grown fruit. Our flagship Pear Brandy takes 20 lbs of pears to make one 700 ml bottle. OUR UNAGED BRANDIES INCLUDE: Pear Brandy, Pear in Bottle, Blue Plum (Slivovitz) Brandy, Cherry (Kirschwasser) Brandy, Douglas Fir Brandy, and Raspberry (Framboise) Brandy AWARDS & ACCOLADES New Orleans Spirits Competition – Double Gold & Best of Category (2026) Platinum – SIP Magazine’s Best of the Northwest (2025) Gold – Bartender Spirits Awards (2021) BARREL AGED BRANDIES Many of our fruit brandies do not benefit from the barrel aging, so we leave them water clear and unchanged. Apple and grape brandies are the exception to this rule. They mature beautifully in French Oak barrels, which give them additional depth and complexity. OUR AGED BRANDIES INCLUDE: 2-Year Apple Brandy, 8-Year Apple Brandy Aged 8 Years, and Oregon Brandy (Aged 2 Years) LIQUEURS Clear Creek Distillery liqueurs can be enjoyed after dinner served neat in a cordial glass, in cocktails, with champagne for a “Kir Royale”, or over good vanilla ice cream. The applications are limitless. They are truly delicious. OUR LIQUEURS INCLUDE: Cranberry Liqueur, Cassis Liqueur, Cherry Liqueur, Loganberry Liqueur, Marionberry Liqueur, Pear Liqueur, and Raspberry Liqueur GRAPPA Grappa is the clear brandy distilled from pressed grapes, also called pomace. These pressed skins, stems and seeds of grapes (a winemaker’s leftovers) are shoveled by hand into the pot stills. The clear spirit distilled from this pomace is the grappa. Like wine, grappa can vary widely depending on the quality and variety of grape and the techniques used to make it. In Italy it is traditional to serve grappa at the end of a meal where it is thought to aid in digestion. OUR GRAPPA INCLUDES: Grappa Muscat VODKA Clear Creek Vodka is 100 percent fruit-based—fermented and distilled from 14 different varietals of non-GMO apples grown in the Pacific Northwest—and cut to 80 proof with glacier-fed spring water from Mt. Hood. Distilled using a 46-chamber column still, Clear Creek Vodka is not flavored, but offers the perfect combination of minerality and brightness accented with mild notes of crushed apple blossom.
