Come by on most Thursday evenings during Fall, Winter & Spring to enjoy live music in Warren and Saturday Nights in Jamestown. Who knows, maybe you'll find your new favorite performer! We are located in Cayuga NY just 500 feet off historic U.S. Rt. 20 between Auburn and Seneca Falls in the Finger Lakes region. We specialize in small group tastings and personalized attention. OUR WINES Our wine offering is a reflection of the Finger Lakes wine region. We offer Riesling, Chardonnay and Cabernet Franc as well as new hybrids and traditional favorites from the past. We like to pour and discuss a "Finger Lakes Sampler" providing visitors with a fairly broad experience to what the region has to offer. OUR VENUE Along with the signature White Barn the venue features our petite vineyards, two ponds and a large green space for recreating or celebrating your special event. Wines grown on the property are from Cornell University and the University of Minnesota grape breeding programs. They have been selected for their cold hardy tolerance and diverse characteristics. You can take it all in while enjoying a glass on our patio. From Apple Orchard to Winery About Our Winning Winemaker As an avid engineer and entrepreneur at heart, Kevin Behnke has been a forward-thinking visionary who is always on-the-go. At just 25 years old, Kevin purchased a small machine shop with the idea of expanding it to a machinery rebuilding company to service manufacturers nationally. The company has given him great joy in doing what he does best: building something from nothing or repairing things to its former glory. In 2002, Kevin acquired the formerly known Apple Works orchard as a real estate investment and as a potential new home for his family. Given the hundreds of apple trees on the property, in 2007, he decided to harvest them to make wine, at first, only as a hobby. As time went on, he set out to produce more than just apple-related products and began experimenting with more traditional, warm-climate grape winemaking. For fun, he would enter amateur wine contests and found himself winning bronze, silver, and even gold medals throughout the Midwest. Knowing his wine was well-received, he decided to turn his once hobby into a business that would allow him to share his love of unique wine with those looking for something different. Kevin renovated the once orchard garage storefront into what now is the wine tasting room, which is filled with his personal craftsmanship both inside and out. Kevin spends a lot of his time experimenting with new recipes and hopes the winery continues to produce fine, handcrafted wines. Learn More Events Wine Release Parties, Private Events, and more. Water-borne epidemics during this period were commonplace, and the boiling of beer during the brewing process, made it a far healthier option than the town’s water supply. SO MONKS BREWED. What made monastic breweries different was that the monks brought patience, process and dedication to the practice of brewing. At Monkless, there are no monks, but this is our devotion. We practice patience to perfection in our brewing process, and focus exclusively on Belgian-style ales. OUR BIERS Our classic Belgian-style ales are crafted to be accessible, refined & smooth. Consistency is critical and we never rush the process. We patiently enable the distinctive Belgian-style yeast to work their magic and don’t obscure their efforts with bold hop bitterness, or excessive adjunct spices, which detract from the old world character of the beer. We strive to be authentic to style, and focus on innovation in our interpretation and approach. Like a monk’s ascetic practice, our palates tend to evolve through experience, and with beer it’s no different. Belgian-style beers are meant to be experienced, enjoyed, and appreciated. Welcome to the Heart of the Valley Nested within our century-old family orchards, Mt. Hood Winery is a place where volcanic soils, warm Oregon sun and cool alpine breezes meet generations of farming heritage. Whether you are finishing a hike through the Gorge or exploring the iconic Hood River Fruit Loop, we invite you to find a seat on our patio, breathe in the views of Wy’East (Mt. Hood) and Klickitat (Mt. Adams), and savor a glass of our award-winning estate wine. Visit & Savor Daily Tasting Room & Patio Hours We are delighted to welcome you, 12:00 PM - 5:00 PM Friday - Wednesday 12:00 PM - 6:00 PM Thursday Walk-ins are always welcome for flights and glass pours on a first-come, first-served basis. Our Location: 2882 Van Horn Drive Hood River, Oregon 97031 Get Directions - Apple Maps Outside Food & Charcuterie Options : Guests are welcome to bring their own food, picnic items, and snacks to enjoy during their visit. We also offer locally sourced build-your-own charcuterie boxes along with a selection of small bite options available for purchase at the tasting room. Planning Your Trip A Place for Everyone We are proud to be a dog-friendly and family-friendly winery. Relax under our pergola or find a spot in our spacious tasting room, we look forward to sharing our harvest with you. Groups & Gatherings To ensure the best possible experience for all our guests, we ask that parties of 6 or more contact us in advance. For large groups and tour buses, a scheduled appointment is required so we can prepare a dedicated space for your tasting. Call to Inquire - (541) 386-8333 or email hallie@mthoodwine.com Train Schedule Reservation Policy Due to our partnership with the Mount Hood Railroad, we do not accept reservations during scheduled train stop times at the winery. During these periods, the winery may experience very high traffic levels, with trains bringing up to 300 guests per stop, depending on the day . Walk-ins are still welcome, and we offer a condensed menu featuring bottles, glass pours, and three-wine tasting flights during train hours. Please view the Train Schedule on our Groups & Bookings Page when planning your visit. Reserve for 6+ Guests Join Us in The Tasting Room Open daily for flights and glass pours. Take in the dual views of Mt. Hood and Mt. Adams from our patio or relax by the fireplace. Reserve A Table (6+ People) Summit Wine Club Join our family for exclusive releases, member-only events, and a deeper connection to the Century Farm. Join Our Summit Club Live Music Every Thursday | April through October Music typically begins at 4:00 PM and continues until 6:00 PM. All performances are complimentary for our tasting room guests. Live Music Lineup Wine Shop From our 2016 "Winery of the Year" Pinot Noir to our signature Pear Bubbly, bring the taste of Hood River Valley home. Our Wine List Our Wines Estate Pinot Noir Reserve The pinnacle of our estate vineyards, this Pinot Noir is crafted from a rigorous selection of our finest barrels and aged in 50% new French oak from the legendary Alain Fouquet cooperage. It opens with inviting aromas of ripe red fruit, delicate floral notes, and subtle spice. On the palate, layers of vibrant berry, earthy nuance, and gentle oak unfold with depth and balance, carried by a silky texture and refined structure. The finish is long and graceful, leaving a lingering impression of fruit, spice, and polished tannin. A wine made for lingering conversations, quiet reflection, or an exceptional steak. Full Winelist Pinot Noir Crafted predominantly from the premium Pommard clone grown on our estate vineyards, this Pinot Noir is designed around exceptional quality and pigment. This stunning property, graced by majestic oak trees and nestled in the afternoon shade of the Mayacamas Mountains, forms the very essence of our winery. Visit our tasting room daily 11am-5pm. | Madroña Vineyards | Madroña Vineyards — Estate Wines from El Dorado County | skip to main content Skip to chat Shop ABOUT WINES VIDEOS VISIT CLUBS EVENTS BLOG CONTACT At Madroña, we make exceptional wines that are a simple, yet powerful, reflection of this special place, meant to be enjoyed at table with family and friends. Open daily 11am–5pm Join us for a relaxing, seated tasting to enjoy our exceptional mountain-grown wines. Reservations aren’t needed, however, if you would like to guarantee a table, please call the winery at 530-644-5948. Tastings cost $15.00 and of that, $5.00 can be applied to a purchase of wine. Our picnic tables sit 6 comfortably and our wine barrel tables fit 4-6. There are indoor and outdoor seating options year-round. Madrona is family and pet friendly; picnics can be enjoyed outside, and well-behaved dogs on a leash are always welcome. Browse our upcoming events and buy your tickets online. Events Experience Madroña Madroña’s exceptional mountain elevation vineyards offer perfect growing conditions for the wide range of Rhône and Bordeaux varietals we grow here. Well-drained soil and mild temperatures throughout the year produce grapes with mild acidity and optimal maturity. This distinctive fruit creates the perfect foundation for our unique family of estate grown and bottled wines. Situated at 3,000 feet in the El Dorado County Appellation, Madroña consists of three family-owned vineyards — our Madroña vineyard, located in Apple Hill, and our Enyé and Sumu-Kaw vineyards, located in nearby Pleasant Valley. These three unique vineyard sites are planted with over 26 varietals, carefully selected for their unique winemaking characteristics and blending qualities. Wines Hillside Wines Signature Wines Single Vineyard Wines Specialty Wines New-World Port Wine Specials Hillside wines Hillside Collection wines are quality, estate-grown, varietal wines carefully crafted to complement a wide variety of foods and perfect for everyday meals and casual occasions. Grapes come from our three El Dorado Appellation vineyards, whose mild climate and deep soils provide perfect growing conditions for the wide range of varieties that are the foundation for these wines. co0wvh1.title: Albia Brewing Company
co0wvh1.txt: Albia Brewing Company | Albia Brewing Company | | Come in for a pint! | Brew Trail | Albia Brewing Company | About Us News Where is Albia? Contact Us Sunday, December 16, 2012 Albia Brewing Company The first batch of beer was made in the Lindberg household in 1981 and involved both Brian and Barbara. Brian made the beer and Barbara tolerated it. The first two batches weren't anything to brag about. Several years went by without trying another batch until the craft beer industry started taking hold in America. We started with five gallon batches, then went to fifteen gallon batches, doing one to two batches a day. We also started thinking about finding a building that we could take this hobby to and get the equipment we had accumulated out of the garage. In 2012, we moved to Skean's Block, on the north side of the historic Albia square, which was built in 1889 by Elmer Skean and first served as a grocery store on one side and a boot store on the other. The whole building was remodeled in 1996, as part of the Bates Foundation. We feel like this is more Albia's business than our own. We are watching over the building and enjoying our hobby of making hand-crafted beers. We want you to feel at home when you arrive and like you are stepping back in time. Ask us about the photos of Albia on the walls, as well as those of our ancestors. Posted by MWilson at 7:46 PM Email This BlogThis! c21gvgl.title: Home - Laurel Gray Vineyards
c21gvgl.txt: Home - Laurel Gray Vineyards | View Cart, contains 0 items | Laurel Gray Vineyards | Primary | Child menu of Our Story | Child menu of Events | Laurel Gray Vineyards | Open menu | | | | Facebook | Instagram | Scroll to top | Scroll to top | Close menu | Primary Mobile | On a gentle slope in the Swan Creek AVA of the Yadkin Valley is Laurel Gray Vineyards, a place where you’ll discover a family owned award-winning winery and | Home - Laurel Gray Vineyards | Laurel Gray Vineyards | Skip to content Log in Cart 0 Wines Our Story Wine Club Tastings & Tours Events Gallery Contact Award-Winning North Carolina Wines Inspired by Passion and Generations of Sustainable Farming On a gentle slope in the Swan Creek AVA of the Yadkin Valley is Laurel Gray Vineyards, a place where you’ll discover a family owned award-winning winery and vineyard. For 10-generations the Myers family has farmed this valley since they were granted 400-acres of land by Queen Charlotte of England in 1773. Fast forward to 1999 when Ben and Kim Myers’ dream of preserving a beautiful family farm inspired them to plant French wine grapes and convert an old milking parlor into what is the LG tasting room today. For over 25-years the Myers family has sustainably farmed these vineyards and proudly produce what wine critics call some the best award- winning wines in not only North Carolina but the East Coast. Benny and Kim would like to invite you to come and enjoy the fruits of their labor and share in some fine wine and warm Southern hospitality. TASTINGS & TOURS WINE SHOP UPCOMING EVENTS What Our Guests Say About Laurel Gray Vineyards Absolutely beautiful place, fantastic wines. – Sharon K. We stopped by the vineyard and we were extremely surprised with the dry wines we discovered at Laurel Gray. This is one of the wineries that is changing that old idea that only sweet wines come from NC. Not the case – the dry wines produced here are phenomenal. – Sharon L. Very generous and inviting tasting experience. Tremendous value for the price. Friendly people, great venue to relax in with one of their great wines. We will be back. – Lisa K. A must go to Winery in the Yadkin Valley. 5-Stars – Steve B. I just had a bottle of the ’15 Merlot with an herb roasted beef brisket! The brisket was great…the Merlot was amazing! Everybody at the table was insane about it and asked how I was lucky enough to put hands on wine like that! – Dan H. We love their wines! Family owned and operated. French wines found in the Yadkin Valley. – Cathy W. The folks at Laurel Gray are fabulous! The wine is too! – Lulu D. Tuesday, November 24 Friendsgiving Wednesday, November 25 Repeal Day Saturday, December 05 From one family to another — welcome to McMenamins! Olympia's beloved Spar Café was family-owned for 60 of its 70 years of existence and then changed hands to another Pacific Northwest family — ours! From its original days as a blue-collar joint for dockworkers and loggers to its modern reinterpretation as a gathering spot for students, politicians and legislators, The Spar has a long-running history as an anchor of the community. Have a look at an excerpt from our newsletter for a story on the Spar's past. McMenamins is pleased to continue the family tradition, with a nod to its past and an eye on its future. We offer family-friendly breakfast, lunch and dinner menus, including such McMenamins staples as hearty pancakes, house-made granola, burgers, fresh salads, seasonal specials and more, along with a selection of our handcrafted ales, wines and spirits. And while you’re here, you can enjoy a few nostalgic rounds of pinball, or get a group together for shuffle board or pinball. Some of you may remember the Olympia Beer ads of the early ‘80s announcing “It’s the water.” We can’t confirm or deny that Artesians (those brewers of the purest water) exist, but we do know that the very same artesian well water bubbles away in the basement of the Spar Café, and even inspired us to make vodka with it. According to one hydrogeologist, the water is from an aquifer called the Tumwater Sand of the Holocene Epoch, a deposit of the Deschutes River (in Washington, not Oregon) The sand was deposited as the Deschutes re-established its channel after the last glacier withdrew from the Puget Sound, about 12,000 years ago – and this is the very water you drink in the pub and in our Spar Vodka. It’s the largest freshwater island in the world, there’s water everywhere, and it’s densely populated with both Indigenous and non-Indigenous communities,” Nishin Meawasige, co-owner of the Manitoulin Brewing Company (MBC) “Manitoulin” is an Ojibwe word meaning “great spirit.” The island is in Lake Huron, and those who visit instantly appreciate the deeper meaning of its Indigenous name. For us, the island is the inspiration for MBC, the independent craft brewery Nishin co-founded with friend Blair Hagman in 2015. In 2019, the pair brought on a third partner, Holden Rhodes, and the three of them are building on previous successes and looking to bring more MBC products to all of Ontario and beyond. Manitoulin Island and the surrounding area are home base, and the brewery is an extension of the place they cherish. The branding behind our products is all based on landmarks here on the island. We’re promoting the island to the world. These are real places with real stories that people can learn about and experience when they come to Manitoulin Island. Originally founded by brothers Joseph and Leonhard Eppig, their brewing empire flourished through the early 1900s, even weathering the challenges of Prohibition in its own discreet way. Nearly 150 years after the first family brewery was established in Brooklyn, New York, Stephanie Eppig and her partners proudly revived the Eppig Brewing tradition, bringing its storied history and dedication to exceptional craft beer into the modern era. The beer made it into the fermenter…and then sat there for five years. He gave up on brewing until he discovered a local homebrew store and began brewing extract kits in a turkey fryer. There were more bad batches than good ones—ask him sometime about the infamous root beer–flavored brown ale (this was before root beer ales were cool). As Dan improved, he moved into all-grain brewing and eventually built an electric brewing setup in his basement. It was going great—until he almost burned the house down and flooded the finished basement with wort. ​ Around 2014, during a Mission Community (Bible Study) group at church, Dan began sharing his brewing journey with friends. Winery A visit to Sleepy Creek is like visiting a friend where you can come as you are, drink and eat what you like and relax in a friendly, comfortable atmosphere. Easy to find and just a short drive from Champaign, IL, we offer wine samples, wine flights, wine by the glass and bottles to take home. Relax while sitting inside the tasting room or outside by the pond, enjoy some local cheese, pizza, and other food/snacks and browse the gift shop. Our wines are made on site from our very own grapes, as well as fruit from other growers. Tours and VIP tastings are also available by appointment. Planning A Visit › Our Wines › Tours and Tasting › Events The beautiful wood timber frame barn that is home to the winery and tasting room is the perfect setting for both public and private events. In addition to the winery, we have a separate venue directly behind the winery called the “Dragonfly”. Throughout the year you can attend house concerts, comedy shows, theatrical performances, the annual Sleepy Creek Art & Music Festival. Check our calendar of events for more information or visit our Facebook page for all the happenings at Sleepy Creek. Our rustic setting is also available for selected private events. We host intimate private events inside our tasting room for up to 75 people after business hours and the “Dragonfly" will host up to 250 guest weddings and other events. Calendar of Events › Private Event Information › Wedding Information › Lodging We invite you to sip and stay in our lodging. There will be no awkward breakfast conversations with an innkeeper and other guests you do not know. With a fully-equipped kitchen, enjoy cooking your own breakfast. Rental includes a bottle of our wine and all linens. Located just 30 miles from Champaign-Urbana and about 2 hours from Chicago and Indianapolis, the rustic B & W at Sleepy Creek is a serene location to unwine. Uh, that is, unwind. Beer, Cocktails, Live Music & Events | HOMEOUR STORYLOCATIONSTHE BARREL ROOMUPCOMING EVENTSTAP LISTFIND OUR BEER!DISTRIBUTION INFOCONTACT US/HOURSFAQFOLLOW FACEBOOK INSTAGRAM 0 BREWERY In May 2018, we opened our doors and poured our very first rounds of Harbor Brewing beer. Since then, we’ve grown far beyond those early days, expanding our taproom, brewing equipment, staff, hours, and everything in between. Today, our Lake Villa taproom offers a little something for everyone, with **24 taps featuring our latest beers, cocktails, non-alcoholic options, live music, bingo, trivia nights and games ** where you can channel your inner child. We also host a variety of events throughout the year and offer spaces for private parties and celebrations. Whether you’re stopping in for a fresh pint, catching a live band, playing some games, or planning your next event, there’s always something happening at Harbor Brewing. Stop in and see what’s on tap, or click below to learn more about hosting your next party with us! HOST AN EVENT! BEER At Harbor Brewing Company, beer is more than a career—it’s our passion. Like many breweries, our story started in a garage, where countless late nights, early mornings, and plenty of trial and error eventually led us to making some damn good beer. A few years later, after many more long nights and rough mornings, that passion became a reality when we opened our doors. We’re still driven by that same passion today. We’re constantly brewing new beers, expanding our tap list, experimenting with different styles, and creating new collaborations. In 2026, that hard work was recognized with two Gold Medals at the U.S. Beer Open Championships. Click below to see what’s currently on tap for your next visit! Come chill in cozy confines of our Bierhall or the shade of our Biergarten Home Events Menus Beers Venue News Online Store Gallery Columbia’s Original Riverfront Brewery, Restaurant, and Biergarten Located in Canalside Apartment Complex Willkommen to Bierkeller Brewing Company! Your experience is sure to feel like a true German home away from home. Whether you're relaxing in our spacious, shaded Biergarten or settling into our open and welcoming Bierhall, you’ll feel like you’ve stepped into a traditional tavern in Bamberg, Munich, or Salzburg. While you're in the area, enjoy the sights of Riverfront Park, our neighbor along the beautiful Three Rivers Greenway; Riverbanks Zoo just upstream; and the nearby State and EdVenture Museums. Embracing centuries-old brewing traditions, we pour our exclusively German-style beers directly from the lagering tanks. You won't find a fresher beer anywhere! Pair a lager with some delicious German food and great company (or a book), and you'll see for yourself what all the talk is about! (If beer isn't your style, we also carry wine, cider, non-alcoholic beer, and soft drinks/juices.) Bierkeller is family-friendly, and we welcome well-behaved, leashed dogs in our Biergarten. Check out our events calendar for more information on events, specials, trivia, soccer, and live music. PROST! A neighborhood brewery with community at its heart. 5812 East Burnside Street - Portland, Oregon Follow us on Instagram! Visit our store Welcome. Established in 2014, Leikam Brewing is a certified kosher, community-centric, and family-operated 5BBL brewery. We started Leikam Brewing with a simple belief: beer tastes better when it brings people together. What began as a home brewing adventure in 2007 grew into a family-owned brewery and taproom in Portland, Oregon. Since opening our doors in 2014, we've worked to create something bigger than a place to grab a pint. We're proudly Jewish, woman-owned, and kosher-certified. Our identity shapes how we approach hospitality, community, and the connections that happen around a shared table. We call it radical hospitality: the belief that everyone deserves to feel welcome, valued, and included. You'll find that spirit in everything we do, from our beers to our trivia nights, live music, cultural celebrations, craft gatherings, and spontaneous conversations between strangers who become friends. You don't need to know anything about beer or Jewish culture to belong here. Whether you're here for trivia, a holiday celebration, a quiet pint, or to meet your new favorite people, there's a place for you at our table. Just come as you are. Pull up a chair. There's room for you. Cheers, Sonia Marie & Theo Leikam Check out what's happening Drink Menu Host Your Event Here View fullsize View fullsize View fullsize View fullsize View fullsize View fullsize WATCH: Great Beers, you can’t help but Leikam. The company initially produced apple and pear brandies, using excess fruit from the valley’s abundant harvests. Over the years, Hood River Distillers expanded its product range to include a diverse array of spirits such as vodka, gin, rum, and whiskey, inspired by the beautiful Pacific Northwest. Today, Hood River Distillers continues to uphold its tradition of quality craftsmanship while embracing innovation. With a portfolio that includes award-winning spirits, the distillery remains a testament to the determination and passion of its founders, earning its place as a beloved and respected name in the spirits industry. Located along the Columbia River with majestic Mt. Hood as its backdrop, Hood River Distillers has been at its current bottling facility in Hood River since 1969. A NEW ICON WINE, 2022 NARAVANE Discover Naravane 2022 NARAVANE THE SECOND VINTAGE OF OUR ICON WINE We are proud to announce the release of the second vintage of our icon wine - the 2022 Naravane Cabernet Sauvignon. The limited-edition namesake release celebrates the power and elegance of Cabernet Sauvignon and is inspired by the grit and grace of generations of Naravane matriarchs. When we founded Rasa Vineyards in Walla Walla in 2007, we felt we’d stumbled upon a hidden gem – an area with incredibly diverse terroir capable of high-quality winemaking and a still-nascent wine industry that would allow us the freedom to develop our own unique approach to Bordeaux- and Rhône-style wines. The release of our newest wine, the 2022 Naravane Cabernet, is the culmination of 19 years of honing our craft to produce the second vintage of our namesake wine that honors the terroir of the Columbia Valley and interplay of power and finesse possible with Cabernet. This wine is also deeply personal to us and is an homage to our mother and grandmother, whose fortitude, strength and love shaped our own journey as people and entrepreneurs. The 2022 Naravane Cabernet Sauvignon features a blend of the highest-quality Cabernet Sauvignon grapes hand-picked from four carefully selected vineyards in Columbia Valley, including Red Mountain’s Ciel du Cheval, planted to vines in 1975. In 2022, these vineyards yielded grapes with high fruit concentration, intensity and depth of phenolics. Craft • Culture • Diversity • Community About The Founder Carmen A Velasco was born in San Diego California and grew up in and around Barrio Logan as a child. Coming from a real estate background, she knew what it took to build a powerful brand and has with MBH. Her passion was found in expressing her culture, her memories and the culture through craft beer and events at the brewery. One of her innovations included creating Mujeres Brew Club, which was focused on craft beer education and building a supportive network of women. That was wildly successful and grew during the pandemic into acquiring a turnkey brewery in Logan Heights and dedicating to women in the Bread & Salt Art Hub of Logan Heights. Mujeres Brew House has since grown tremendously into a real-world example of what women can do when given the space to explore their own palate, their own passions, and their own recipes. Most of all, | Twisted Horn Mead & Cider | Mead Hall | Twisted Horn Mead & Cider | Award Winning San Diego Meadery | Twisted Horn Mead & Cider | Award Winning San Diego Meadery | San Diego County's first meadery & cidery. 17 rotating taps of award winning mead & ciders. | TAPLISTFOOD MENUMEAD STOREEVENTSABOUT USBLOGCONTACT US VIEW TAPLIST & TO-GO MENU SEE UPCOMING EVENTS BUY MEAD ONLINE San Diego meadery & cidery Come visit Twisted Horn Mead & Cider, the only Viking inspired mead hall in San Diego, CA that features our perfectly crafted award winning mead and cider. If you cannot visit our taproom, you can order online and have our mead shipped straight to your door. Our tasting room is open Wednesday through Sunday, is pet friendly and fully air conditioned for your comfort! Whether you are a seasoned connoisseur or a newcomer to mead and cider, our knowledgeable staff stands ready to guide you through a tasting journey unlike any other. Enjoy new flavors and old favorites from our wide selection of award winning meads and ciders flowing from our 17 taps! PRIVATE EVENTS FOOD MENU BUY ONLINE New Flavors and Old Favorites!! “Armor Class Zero” Mead We answered the call for a bone dry mead and made our Armor Class Zero. We used a combination of Alfalfa and Clover Honey’s and fermented down to dry dry while still maintaining the bold honey character. I think I nailed it. Cheers! “Hidden Stones” Cider This absolutely amazing apple cider was made with fresh pressed apple juice, lush yellow peach and the spicy zing of ginger root. Perfect for the hot summer days. Cheers! “Basilisk” Mead This incredible mead was made using Alfalfa and Clover honeys, strawberry, lemon and Italian Basil. A hint of sweet fruit to perfectly compliment its savory nature. Enjoy! WHAT'S ON TAP Twisted Horn Rewards Program Get Discounts on Mead & Cider! Sign up with your phone number and email and start earning discounts on mead and cider immediately. After signing up, give your bartender your phone number to bring up your points. No Apps Required! SIGN UP HERE Mead and Cider: The Real Story Mead and cider’s histories date back thousands of years to when something that wasn’t quite beer and wasn’t quite wine emerged on the market. Unique and fantastical drinks indeed they were that offered flavors that beer and traditional wines could not. As time passed, fruits, spices and other adjunct flavors were also added to further enhance the already unique flavor profiles. Capitalizing on creativity and only using the best quality of those very ingredients, is what gave rise to this truly unique and extraordinary location. Within our hallowed halls, our mead and cider making is serious business, and we make sure to provide only the most worthy of beverages to our honored guests. Head over to our about us page to learn more about the story of our mead and cider and why we like to describe our offerings as “Old World Style With a Twist”. What is Mead? Mead is the oldest know fermented beverage on the planet (it predates all other forms by hundreds if not thousands of years) and was once called the drink of Gods and Kings. In it’s most basic form, mead is three things: honey, water, and yeast, and when it is done right, these three ingredients can come together to make one incredible libation. Twisted Horn brings the experience of “aged” times to life with every glass and bottle that we serve! If you wish to buy mead in Southern California, the object of your quest for the best meads that can be found are in Vista in our very own one of a kind viking mead hall. For those residing in far distant lands, our assortment of meads can be found in our online store. So come forth and order your fill! Tell Me About the Cider ? Our unique hard cider is artistically crafted from primarily using either apples or pears and imbues the drinker with feelings of exquisite satisfaction, an enticing alcoholic beverage the likes of which the cider world has never known. Like our tantalizing mead, our cider is often combined with different fruits to create a vast variety of complex, unparalleled flavor experiences. Once you have seen our selection of ciders, you will never need to venture anywhere else in the Southern California region. With great passion for our art, we select only the best fruit in the batch and are always eager to bring only the most extraordinary flavor combinations

We craft small batch, unique spirits from grain to glass. Our focus is on Whisky production using the best local ingredients to give you a product that's truly special. We want each batch of whisky to be crafted with care from start-to finish. We do this by using double pot distillation techniques that give you maximum flavor for your drink!
